title: Map recurring locations and outfits to short tokens in your prompt (e.g…
content:
Map recurring locations and outfits to short tokens in your prompt (e.g., Location mapping: (details) -> LOC01; Wardrobe mapping: (details) -> EV01/RS01) and then reference those tokens in each shot line to keep continuity across jump cuts.  
Use a structured shot syntax like [CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ... to clearly separate camera, location, and wardrobe per edit.  
Define wardrobe tokens from image references when needed (e.g., Wardrobe mapping: @[image1] as EV01; @[image2] as RS01) to lock outfits without lengthy text descriptions.  
Save character limit by using compact mapping notation and ellipses (... -> ...) instead of verbose definitions like "@[image1] defined as ..." when repeating mapped elements.

es.content:
Mapea las ubicaciones y los outfits recurrentes a tokens cortos en tu prompt (por ejemplo, Location mapping: (details) -> LOC01; Wardrobe mapping: (details) -> EV01/RS01) y luego referencia esos tokens en cada línea de plano para mantener la continuidad entre jump cuts.  
Usa una sintaxis estructurada de planos como [CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ... para separar claramente cámara, ubicación y vestuario en cada edición.  
Define los tokens de vestuario a partir de referencias de imagen cuando sea necesario (por ejemplo, Wardrobe mapping: @[image1] as EV01; @[image2] as RS01) para fijar los outfits sin descripciones largas.  
Ahorra caracteres usando una notación de mapeo compacta y puntos suspensivos (... -> ...) en lugar de definiciones verbosas como "@[image1] defined as ..." cuando repitas elementos mapeados.

fr.content:
Mappez les lieux récurrents et les tenues en de courts tokens dans votre prompt (par ex. : Location mapping : (details) -> LOC01 ; Wardrobe mapping : (details) -> EV01/RS01), puis référez-vous à ces tokens dans chaque ligne de plan pour maintenir la continuité à travers les jump cuts.  
Utilisez une syntaxe de plan structurée comme [CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ... pour séparer clairement la caméra, le lieu et la tenue à chaque montage.  
Définissez les tokens de tenue à partir de références d’images lorsque c’est nécessaire (par ex. : Wardrobe mapping : @[image1] as EV01 ; @[image2] as RS01) afin de verrouiller les tenues sans longues descriptions textuelles.  
Gagnez de la place dans la limite de caractères en utilisant une notation de mapping compacte et des ellipses (... -> ...) plutôt que des définitions verbeuses comme "@[image1] defined as ..." lorsque des éléments mappés se répètent.

ja.content:
プロンプト内で、繰り返し登場するロケーションや衣装を短いトークンにマッピングします（例: Location mapping: (details) -> LOC01; Wardrobe mapping: (details) -> EV01/RS01）。そのうえで、各ショット行でそれらのトークンを参照し、ジャンプカットをまたいでも一貫性を保ちます。  
[CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ... のような構造化された shot syntax を使うと、編集ごとに camera、location、wardrobe を明確に分けられます。  
必要に応じて、画像参照から wardrobe token を定義します（例: Wardrobe mapping: @[image1] as EV01; @[image2] as RS01）。これにより、長いテキスト説明なしで衣装を固定できます。  
繰り返し使うマッピング要素については、冗長な "@[image1] defined as ..." のような定義ではなく、コンパクトな mapping notation と省略記号（... -> ...）を使うことで、文字数を節約できます。

[CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ...처럼 구조화된 shot syntax를 사용해 편집마다 camera, location, wardrobe를 명확히 구분하세요.  
필요할 때는 image reference를 바탕으로 wardrobe 토큰을 정의하세요. 예: Wardrobe mapping: @[image1] as EV01; @[image2] as RS01. 이렇게 하면 긴 텍스트 설명 없이도 의상을 고정할 수 있습니다.  
반복되는 요소를 매핑할 때는 "@[image1] defined as ..."처럼 장황한 정의 대신, 간결한 mapping notation과 ellipses (... -> ...)를 사용해 character limit을 절약하세요.

pt.content:
Mapeie locais e figurinos recorrentes em tokens curtos no seu prompt (por exemplo, mapeamento de local: (detalhes) -> LOC01; mapeamento de figurino: (detalhes) -> EV01/RS01) e depois referencie esses tokens em cada linha de cena para manter a continuidade entre jump cuts.  
Use uma sintaxe estruturada de cena, como [CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ... para separar claramente câmera, local e figurino em cada corte.  
Defina tokens de figurino a partir de referências de imagem quando necessário (por exemplo, mapeamento de figurino: @[image1] como EV01; @[image2] como RS01) para fixar os looks sem descrições textuais longas.  
Economize caracteres usando uma notação compacta de mapeamento e reticências (... -> ...) em vez de definições verbosas como "@[image1] definido como ..." ao repetir elementos mapeados.

zh.content:
将重复出现的地点和服装映射为提示词中的简短 token（例如：地点映射：(details) -> LOC01；服装映射：(details) -> EV01/RS01），然后在每个镜头行中引用这些 token，以在跳切之间保持连贯性。  
使用结构化的镜头语法，例如 [CAM] WS, low-angle inside LOC01 -> [ACT] EVAN wearing EV01 -> ...，以便在每次剪辑中清晰地区分 camera、location 和 wardrobe。  
在需要时，可根据图像参考定义服装 token（例如：服装映射：@[image1] as EV01；@[image2] as RS01），以在不使用冗长文字描述的情况下锁定服装。  
通过使用紧凑的映射标记和省略号（... -> ...）来节省字符数，而不是在重复映射元素时使用诸如 "@[image1] defined as ..." 之类冗长的定义。
